an10.68:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā naḷakapāne viharati palāsavane
an10.68:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadahuposathe bhikkhusaṃghaparivuto nisinno hoti
an10.68:1.3: athakho bhagavā bahudeva rattiṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā tuṇhībhūtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ anuviloketvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi
an10.68:2.2: paṭibhātu taṃ sāriputta bhikkhūnaṃ dhammī kathā
an10.68:2.5: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavato paccassosi.
an10.68:3.1: athakho bhagavā catuguṇaṃ saṃghāṭiṃ paññāpetvā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā.
an10.68:3.2: tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi
an10.68:3.4: āvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
an10.68:4.1: yassakassaci āvuso saddhā natthi kusalesu dhammesu hiri natthi …
an10.68:4.9: appamādo natthi kusalesu dhammesu tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati hāniyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuḍḍhi
an10.68:4.10: seyyathāpi āvuso kāḷapakkhe candassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati hāyateva vaṇṇena hāyati maṇḍalena hāyati ābhāya hāyati ārohapariṇāhena
an10.68:4.11: evameva kho āvuso yassakassaci saddhā natthi kusalesu dhammesu hiri natthi …
an10.68:4.19: appamādo natthi kusalesu dhammesu tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati hāniyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuḍḍhi.
an10.68:5.1: yassakassaci āvuso saddhā atthi kusalesu dhammesu hiri atthi …
an10.68:5.9: appamādo atthi kusalesu dhammesu tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati vuḍḍhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no pārihāni
an10.68:5.10: seyyathāpi āvuso juṇhapakkhe candassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati vaḍḍhateva vaṇṇena vaḍḍhati maṇḍalena vaḍḍhati ābhāya vaḍḍhati ārohapariṇāhena
an10.68:5.11: evameva kho āvuso yassakassaci saddhā atthi kusalesu dhammesu hiri atthi … ottappaṃ atthi … viriyaṃ atthi … paññā atthi … sotāvadhānaṃ atthi … dhammadhāraṇā atthi … atthupaparikkhā atthi … dhammānudhammapaṭipatti atthi …
an10.68:5.12: appamādo atthi kusalesu dhammesu tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati vuḍḍhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no pārihānīti.
